provenance.cleanupNotes: Backdrop removed via local RGB-contrast alpha cleanup (Gaussian sigma38px; alpha fade contrast21–42); raw source retained and fifteen pose components isolated at pack.

review.reviewNotes: Fifteen complete Moxie poses in 5x3 layout with consistent human anatomy and identity. Two hands gather and rise overhead, remain together through peak, extend forward/down for the double-hand finish, release at frame10/tick21, then descend and land. No ball is drawn; backdrop cleanup and packed atlas reviewed.

repack.fit: uniform scale, never upscale; max 86px high and cell width minus 10px; centered horizontally and baseline aligned with 5px bottom clearance
